title: Non-Invertible Symmetries and Boundaries for Two-Dimensional Fermions
summary: We study the relation between boundary conditions and categorical symmetries of two-dimensional fermionic conformal field theories. We determine all anomaly-free invertible global symmetries of two free complex Weyl fermions, which take the form $\mathbb{Z}_k$ for each primitive Pythagorean triple $a^2 + b^2 = k^2$. The theory is self-dual under gauging any of these symmetries, and so to each there is associated a non-invertible topological defect. We study the properties of these lines, and show that any conformal boundary condition of two Dirac fermions that preserves a $U(1)^2$ symmetry…
